rationale.formal-methods: Task contracts enable formal specification, testing, and runtime verification.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Executable contracts and targeted tests detect behavioral violations.
rationale.ai-review: LLMs generate contract-guided tests and evaluate mismatches during iterative refinement.
rationale.quality-debt: ATM example demonstrates and mitigates AI-generated logical and maintainability defects.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Maintains traceability among intent, tasks, contracts, and generated code.
rationale.framework: Defines a reusable four-stage contract-driven QA pipeline.
rationale.agentic: A single prompt produces a complete multi-class project artifact.
rationale.steering: Validated contracts substantively constrain and guide subsequent code generation.
rationale.risk-quality: The contribution mitigates correctness, robustness, and maintainability harms.
